sloka: अद्य ते व्यसनं प्राप्तं किं मां त्वमिह वक्ष्यसि।प्रवेष्टुं न त्वया शक्यो न्यग्रोधो राक्षसाधम ।। ६.८७.२९ ।।
transliteration: adya te vyasanaṁ prāptaṁ kiṁ māṁ tvamiha vakṣyasi।praveṣṭuṁ na tvayā śakyo nyagrodho rākṣasādhama ।। 6.87.29 ।।

translations.english: "O Lowly Rakshasa! This worry has come to you today. Entering the banyan tree is not possible for you today."
